The '''Eres system''' was located in the [[Esuain sector/Legends|Esuain sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the terrestrial<ref name="KOTOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Eres III]].<ref name="EGTW" />

A [[Battle of Eres III|battle]] of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] was fought in the Eres [[Star system/Legends|system]] in [[3962 BBY]] between the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] and the [[Republic Military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the engagement, the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] caused significant damage to Eres III.<ref name="EGTW" /> During the [[Jedi Civil War]] of [[3959 BBY]]&ndash;[[3956 BBY]], the Eres system fell within the territory controlled by the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|empire]] founded by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Eres system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-7.<ref name="TEA" />
